title: Report: U.S. pressures Baltics not to say nasty things about Russia
summary_full: Pentagon officials have urged several NATO allies, including the Baltic states, to tone down their public rhetoric about the threat posed by Russia, arguing that some statements by European leaders and official have undermined the continent’s security, according to Lithuanian public media LRT, citing a Reuters report.
